title: Legacy Systems
hook: If it all stops the day I stop showing up, I haven't built a business. I've built a job.
statement: Build things that keep creating value long after you step away.
explainer: Work tied to your personal effort ends when you do. Documented systems, trained teams, and owned assets keep paying out for years. That's what lasts.
sop: List your current major projects and investments.
Ask honestly: does this stop mattering the moment I stop?
Rate Impact, Duration, and Transferability from 1 to 10 each.
Redesign the lowest scorer so it survives without you.
Invest in one long-term asset this quarter over a quick win.
equation_example: Impact 8 × Duration 7 × Transferability 5 = 280. Higher means it keeps creating value without you touching it. Lower means it's tied to your effort and ends when you do.
question: Write down one thing you're building this year that will still matter in 50 years.
closing_statement: Build things that outlive your involvement in them.
caption:
Principle Nº 180: Legacy Systems

If it all stops the day I stop showing up, I haven't built a business. I've built a job.

Build things that keep creating value long after you step away.

Your turn: Write down one thing you're building this year that will still matter in 50 years.
